purpose: Two prospectively frozen diagnostics: lower-dose repair of unusable early-layer settings; new-prompt validation of a heraldic-topic effect observed in the main building-coordinate calibration. No claimed recovery of building self-identity. This followup was designed after inspecting main calibration outputs, before any followup generation. A bounded human-coordinate refinement adds .6 and .65 inside the coarse gap between .55 and .7, with the same two-point search for both same-layer controls. No further adaptive search is planned.
